faceDesign.why: 흐르는 지느러미와 물의 선을 길고 완만한 눈매 및 타원 얼굴로 옮긴다.
cues: ‘spiky ridge’ → 턱선 · 턱끝 각지고 또렷한 턱
몸 형태 quadruped → 눈 간격 눈 사이가 넓은
‘tiny black nose’ → 코 작고 여린 코
faceDesign.adjusted: 다른 종과 넷 이상 겹쳐 원작 단서의 다음 후보로 옮김 — 턱선 · 턱끝 부드럽고 둥근 턱 → 각지고 또렷한 턱

scene: Standing side-on at a low textile display table in an empty heritage silk studio on a rainy afternoon, face turned toward camera, holding a plain folded blue fabric sample in one hand while the other rests separately on the tabletop. Both complete hands within waist-up crop, muted rain light and warm lantern bounce.
outfit: Opaque white and sea-blue sleeveless wrap blouse with a high diagonal neckline, high-waisted long flowing blue skirt and a slim silver sash clasp. Traditional-inspired summer artisan fashion, bare shoulders and arms, fully covered chest and pelvis, tiny fin pendant; no armor.
custom: 1024x1536 vertical. Preserve the approved adult face and haircut. No large fin headpieces, armor, tail sash or creature costume; only the small jewelry described in the outfit remains as her motif. Follow the selected framing. Both complete hands visibly connect to their respective forearms, with one thumb and four separate natural fingers each. No weapons, text, logos or extra figures.
